# Add participation achievements and points

## Problem

The application has no way to recognize student participation or display milestones earned through extracurricular activities.

## Proposed outcome

Introduce a small, configurable achievement system that can recognize milestones such as attending sessions or completing a program.

## Acceptance criteria

- Achievement definitions and award criteria are explicit and configurable by authorized staff.
- Achievements are associated with the correct student and can include a reason and award date.
- Students can view their own achievements; parents can view achievements for linked students.
- Staff can review awards and correct erroneous records.
- If points are included, the system explains how they are earned and maintains a history of changes.
- Achievement tracking does not affect enrollment or attendance records.
